english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a solemn pledge or promise, especially in formal or emotional contexts.
This is the all-purpose choice for a solemn vow or oath, especially in serious or dramatic contexts.

examples.english: I made an oath before the priest that I would take good care of my family.
examples.traditional: 我喺神父面前立咗誓言，話一定會照顧好屋企人。
